node.text: Disciplined fleets; safe passage is a public duty.
We defend civilian routes with coordinated formations, layered shields and visible command ships. Force is a public trust, measured by who makes it home.

Titan - Tech III - Titan Spartan Republic Hull licence: own any Battleship
Whole Republic defense lines take their bearing from this moving fortress.
SPECIAL SKILL Titan: +25% laser damage, +50% shield capacity, six heavy turrets (2.5x damage per shot), four siege-missile tubes (1.9x damage, 55% wider blast, slower reload). Doomsday Lance (DOOMSDAY button): 2.5 s charge, then a 4 s lance straight ahead (2800 range, 60% as wide as the hull) that wipes everything in its path; mission bosses lose ~8% of their hull per lance and titan-class capitals ~2.5% (they take dozens). The titan cannot move, turn or fire while it charges and fires. 90 s cooldown.
STATS Class: Titan Tech III Faction: Spartan Republic Slot size: XL Hull: x14.0 Speed: 24 / 100 Agility: 4 / 100 Turrets: 6 · Missiles: 4 Cargo: x3.0
